title: Ric Flair rushed to hospital hours after revealing scary health issue - New York Post
description: WWE legend Ric Flair, 77, was rushed to a Tampa hospital after falling and injuring his face, hours after revealing a leg blood clot diagnosis.

title: 2 ex-FBI officials charged with lying to Congress about Hunter Biden laptop probe - CBS News
description: Two former FBI agents have each been charged with one count of lying to Congress about the investigation into Hunter Biden's laptop.

title: Bodycam clip released in fatal police shooting of Mississippi one-year-old - BBC
description: The family lawyer says an allegation of shoplifting "does not warrant the death" of a child.

title: Trump to lower Canada tariffs for certain agricultural goods, Collins says - Politico
description: The overall amount of the tariffs on Canadian goods will remain unchanged, they will just be transferred to different imports, according to a White House fact sheet.
